title: Nine Snow Angels
status: concept-proposal (Creative Director, 2026-11-19; not approved; awaiting owner review)
hook_line: Theo made one snow angel. By morning there were nine.
first_visual: Top-down: a small snow angel in a dark garden, a much larger one beside it.

beats.visual: Top-down: a small angel by the gate, and beside it one twice the size.
beats.vo: Theo made one snow angel. By morning there were nine.

beats.visual: Same shot: the camera rises to reveal more angels down the lane, with no tracks.
beats.vo: No footprints. Each one bigger than the last.

beats.visual: Ivy in boots follows the line to the building; the last angel is upright on the wall by Theo's window.
beats.vo: The last one wasn't on the ground.

beats.visual: Ivy bursts into Theo's room; he is asleep; the window is frosted.
Close on the window: a winged frost shape, crisp, on the inside of the glass.
Key moment: the frost arms sweep slowly as if lying in snow; Theo smiles; tiny moth in the frost.
beats.vo: It was on the inside. Still making it.

ending: Its frosted arms sweep slowly while Theo smiles in his sleep.
loop_note: Partial. It ends on the frost angel moving; frame 1 shows an outdoor angel. The visual rhyme invites a rewatch rather than a seamless loop.

concept: A boy makes one snow angel at dusk. By morning a line of ever-larger angels with no footprints leads to the building, up the wall, and inside his frosted window, where one is still being made.

hooks.line: Theo made one snow angel. By morning there were nine.
hooks.first_visual: Top-down: a small snow angel in a dark garden, a much larger one beside it.

hooks.line: Nine snow angels, and not one footprint.
hooks.first_visual: Crane shot: a line of snow angels down a snowy street, no tracks between them.

hooks.line: Who finished my nephew's snow angels?
hooks.first_visual: A child's mitten lying beside a snow angel twice his size.

hooks.line: The last snow angel was on the wall.
hooks.first_visual: An upright snow-angel imprint pressed into the snow on a brick wall beside a window.

hooks.line: I followed the snow angels. They ended in his room.
hooks.first_visual: Frost on a child's window shaped like wings.

setting: Winter Lane outside Vesper Court, after fresh snow; Theo's bedroom window.
conflict: Ivy needs to know what made the angels and whether Theo is safe.
escalation: The angels get bigger with no tracks, climb the wall, then appear on the inside of the frost.
reveal: The frost angel is on the inside of the glass. It is in the room.
